tasks.subject: Task 1: Monorepo skeleton + absorb rmfiles
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Cargo workspace under one nix flake and `make test`, with rmfiles moved in from ~/git/rmfiles and its tests green.

**Files:** Cargo.toml (workspace), flake.nix, nix/overlays/rmapi.nix, .envrc, Makefile, .gitignore, .githooks/pre-commit, crates/rmfiles/** (copied).

**Verify:** `make test` -> rmfiles tests pass.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["Cargo.toml", "flake.nix", "nix/overlays/rmapi.nix", ".envrc", "Makefile", ".gitignore", ".githooks/pre-commit", "crates/rmfiles"], "verifyCommand": "nix develop -c cargo test && nix develop -c cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings", "acceptanceCriteria": ["workspace builds", "rmfiles tests pass", "clippy clean", "Cargo.lock committed"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: docs/ narrative set
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Foundational docs (why/how-it-works/inspiration/glossary) exist; remarkable-pdf-mechanics.md moved in. Independent of the spike (parallelizable).

**Files:** docs/why.md, docs/how-it-works.md, docs/inspiration.md, docs/glossary.md, docs/remarkable-pdf-mechanics.md (moved), docs/README.md.

**Verify:** all five narrative files non-empty; inter-doc links resolve; glossary defines app/handler/document/manifest/region/readback/sync/device.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["docs/why.md", "docs/how-it-works.md", "docs/inspiration.md", "docs/glossary.md", "docs/remarkable-pdf-mechanics.md", "docs/README.md"], "verifyCommand": "bash -c 'for f in why how-it-works inspiration glossary remarkable-pdf-mechanics; do test -s docs/$f.md || exit 1; done && echo OK'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["five narrative files non-empty", "mechanics doc matches source", "links resolve", "glossary terms defined"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Typst spike scaffold - compile to PDF as a library
tasks.description:
**Goal:** spikes/typst-readback crate compiles in-memory Typst to a valid PDF via the Typst library (World + compile + typst-pdf).

**Files:** Cargo.toml (add member), spikes/typst-readback/Cargo.toml, src/lib.rs (compile_pdf), src/world.rs (SpikeWorld), tests/scaffold.rs.

**Verify:** `cargo test -p typst-readback --test scaffold` PASS (PDF header + one page via lopdf).

```json:metadata
{"files": ["Cargo.toml", "spikes/typst-readback/Cargo.toml", "spikes/typst-readback/src/lib.rs", "spikes/typst-readback/src/world.rs", "spikes/typst-readback/tests/scaffold.rs"], "verifyCommand": "nix develop -c cargo test -p typst-readback --test scaffold", "acceptanceCriteria": ["compile_pdf returns %PDF bytes", "one page via lopdf", "runs device-free"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Bar 1 - recover region rects in PDF coordinates (make-or-break)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Typst doc computes labelled region rects, exposes them via metadata+query; converted to PDF bottom-left coords they match where regions render (within 1.0pt, cross-checked against PNG).

**Files:** src/regions.rs (compile_with_regions, TypstRegion, PdfRect, typst_to_pdf_rect), tests/regions.rs, tests/fixtures/regions.typ, src/lib.rs (expose regions).

**Verify:** `cargo test -p typst-readback --test regions` PASS.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["spikes/typst-readback/src/regions.rs", "spikes/typst-readback/tests/regions.rs", "spikes/typst-readback/tests/fixtures/regions.typ", "spikes/typst-readback/src/lib.rs"], "verifyCommand": "nix develop -c cargo test -p typst-readback --test regions", "acceptanceCriteria": ["metadata+query yields label/page/pos/size", "typst_to_pdf_rect converts coords", "recovered rect within 1.0pt of expected", "PNG cross-check: border pixel inside rect"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Bar 2 - tappable internal + external links
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Links survive Typst->PDF as real annotations (internal Dest/GoTo + external URI), verified via lopdf.

**Files:** tests/links.rs, tests/fixtures/links.typ.

**Verify:** `cargo test -p typst-readback --test links` PASS.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["spikes/typst-readback/tests/links.rs", "spikes/typst-readback/tests/fixtures/links.typ"], "verifyCommand": "nix develop -c cargo test -p typst-readback --test links", "acceptanceCriteria": [">=2 Link annotations", "external URI link == https://example.com", "internal Dest or GoTo present"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Bar 3 - HTML content into Typst
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Representative HTML (headings/paragraphs/bold/italic/list/link) converts to Typst markup; compiled PDF text contains expected strings. Limits documented in Task 8.

**Files:** src/html.rs (html_to_typst), tests/html.rs, tests/fixtures/article.html.

**Verify:** `cargo test -p typst-readback --test html` PASS.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["spikes/typst-readback/src/html.rs", "spikes/typst-readback/tests/html.rs", "spikes/typst-readback/tests/fixtures/article.html"], "verifyCommand": "nix develop -c cargo test -p typst-readback --test html", "acceptanceCriteria": ["HTML fixture converts to Typst", "compiled PDF text contains heading/body/list items", "limits noted for findings"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: Bar 5 (structure) - content-only leading-page invariant
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Re-rendering with appended trailing pages leaves leading pages' MediaBox/order intact and a leading region's rect unchanged (within 1.0pt), so rmapi --content-only won't scramble ink.

**Files:** tests/content_only.rs, src/lib.rs (test_docs::{LEADING,V1,V2}).

**Verify:** `cargo test -p typst-readback --test content_only` PASS.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["spikes/typst-readback/tests/content_only.rs", "spikes/typst-readback/src/lib.rs"], "verifyCommand": "nix develop -c cargo test -p typst-readback --test content_only", "acceptanceCriteria": ["v2 has more pages than v1", "first N MediaBoxes identical", "leading region rect unchanged within 1.0pt"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 8: On-device harness + go/no-go findings doc
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Opt-in on-device push (mirrors rmreader rmapi) for manual bars 4 + device-half of 5 + optional stretch full loop; write the spike's go/no-go findings.

**Files:** src/rmapi.rs (push_content_only), tests/on_device.rs (#[ignore]), docs/superpowers/spikes/2026-05-22-typst-readback-findings.md.

**Verify:** `cargo test -p typst-readback` all non-ignored PASS; findings doc has go/no-go verdict.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["spikes/typst-readback/src/rmapi.rs", "spikes/typst-readback/tests/on_device.rs", "docs/superpowers/spikes/2026-05-22-typst-readback-findings.md"], "verifyCommand": "nix develop -c cargo test -p typst-readback", "acceptanceCriteria": ["push_content_only shells out non-interactively", "on_device test ignored by default", "findings doc states go/no-go + per-bar results"]}
```
